lead.title: FCC Drone Order Passes 3-0, Trusty Says 800 MHz Band Covers Drones
lead.summary: The Federal Communications Commission (FCC) adopted its “Unleashing American Drone Dominance” spectrum order on Thursday, November 19, with Chairman Brendan Carr and Commissioners Anna Gomez and Olivia Trusty all approving. The Report and Order, FCC 26-81, opens the 450 MHz band to drone control links, lets ground radars track drones at 24.45 to 24.65 GHz, and rewrites the rules for the 800 MHz air-ground band that carries in-flight internet.

The commission also allowed ground-based radar systems to use the 24.45–24.65 GHz band to detect and track unauthorised or dangerous UAS near airports, borders, prisons, stadiums, and critical infrastructure.

leads.summary: Tesla began taking preorders for its $29,990 two-seat Cybercab robotaxi from select U.S. consumers on the 13th, with deliveries scheduled to begin next month. The vehicle, which entered mass production this year, is expected to take a substantial share of demand for other vehicles and reduce demand for purchased battery cells as Tesla plans to produce its own battery cells.

stories.title: Kennedy Space Center Holiday Drone Show Jumps From 600 to 1,000 Drones
stories.summary: Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex will fly 1,000 drones over its Rocket Garden every night from December 20 to December 30, 2026, except Christmas Day. The show starts at 6:50 p.m. and is included with regular admission, which is $77 for adults and $67 for children aged 3 to 11.

stories.title: Archer and Disney Imagineering Begin Exploratory Electric Aircraft Research Collaboration
US invites C-UAS industry to new threat coordination group meeting
stories.summary: The US Army intends to convene a Fires Threat Coordination Group to facilitate dialogue with cleared industry partners regarding emerging threats, including counter-unmanned aerial systems. Eligible companies with facility clearance are invited to attend a classified event in Charlottesville, Virginia in February 2027, with responses due by January 4 2027.

stories.title: Ukrainian forces strike Russian elite 'Rubicon' drone unit deployment site in Russian Kursk Oblast
stories.summary: Ukraine's 8th Air Assault Corps struck the deployment site of Russia's Rubicon-S drone unit in Rylsk, Kursk Oblast, on Nov. 20. The attack hit accommodation facilities and workshops, following a Nov. 7 strike on a Rubicon site in Berdiansk, Zaporizhzhia Oblast.

stories.title: Vertical Aerospace Appoints Mudrick Capital Founder to Board
Russian drone enters Moldovan airspace during massive overnight attack on Ukraine
stories.summary: Moldova's Defense Ministry said a Russian drone violated Moldovan airspace for about nine minutes overnight during a massive Russian attack on Ukraine. The drone entered from the direction of Sadkivtsi in Ukraine’s Vinnytsia Oblast and left at 1:28 a.m. on Nov. 20.

stories.title: India and Malaysia train on countering terrorist drones
stories.summary: Malaysian and Indian defence forces began Exercise HARIMAU SHAKTI in Ipoh, Malaysia, on 19 November to rehearse counter-terrorism operations and counter-unmanned aerial systems capabilities. Approximately 120 personnel from each country will conduct joint tactical drills in jungle and semi-urban terrain until 30 November, culminating in a simulated counter-terrorism scenario.

stories.title: FAA Advances AAM Integration With eIPP Demonstration Flights, Certification Steps, New Primer and Draft Vertiport Circular
stories.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration created the eVTOL and AAM Integration Pilot Program (eIPP) to accelerate deployment by seeking proposals from state, local, tribal and territorial governments partnered with private-sector organizations. The program aims to help the FAA develop regulatory frameworks and safety standards using data from demonstration flights.

stories.title: China eVTOL News Briefs: Suppliers' Roles in CE-25A and W5000 Test Flights, Boeing Executive on C919 Progress, C919 Safety Alliance Priorities
stories.summary: Suppliers detailed their roles in the test flights of the CE-25A and the W5000, while a Boeing executive described the progress of China's C919 airliner as "amazing." A C919 safety alliance also set its priorities for its next stage.

stories.title: Russian drone warhead weighing about 50 kg removed from residential building in Kyiv
stories.summary: Bomb disposal experts removed a 50 kg unexploded drone warhead from a residential building in Kyiv’s Podilskyi district. Law enforcement officials said the blast could have destroyed all five floors of the building.

stories.title: Auterion and SkyFall plan German drone factory to boost Ukrainian production
stories.summary: The provided article text does not contain information about Auterion, SkyFall, or a German drone factory.

stories.title: EASA Counts No Drone Deaths in 2025, but One Fell Into a Balloon
stories.summary: The European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) recorded no deaths from civil drones in 2025, counting 27 accidents and 12 serious incidents in its Annual Safety Review 2026. A 249-gram drone hit a hot-air balloon carrying eight people, resulting in one minor injury, while EASA ranked airborne collision as the top safety risk based on 3,667 drone reports with risk scores from 2023 through 2025.

stories.title: Unifly adds UTM and U-space support to EDF’s SPECTRE drone threat project
stories.summary: Unifly joined SPECTRE, a 24-month European Defence Fund project starting 1 November 2026, to provide UTM and U-space services that link civil drone traffic management with counter-unmanned aircraft systems. The consortium will validate the architecture in demonstrations in Belgium, Germany, and Estonia over the next two years.

stories.title: Nordic Air Defence Unveils K200 Drone Interceptor
stories.summary: Stockholm-based Nordic Air Defence unveiled the K200, an autonomous fixed-wing interceptor carrying a 500g warhead designed to counter drones at a fraction of the cost of conventional air defence missiles. The company opened an office in Ukraine to support testing of the system, which can be launched from the ground, vehicles, or maritime vessels.

stories.title: How Ukraine used 11 weapons systems to strike Russia’s Kerch Bridge
stories.summary: Ukraine used 11 types of drones and missiles in a weeks-long operation against Russia’s Kerch Bridge, culminating in strikes that brought down a major section of the road crossing and damaged the parallel railway linking Russia with Crimea.

stories.title: FG Applauds Progress On Kaduna-Kano Rail Project, Reaffirms December Deadline For Commissioning
Egypt announces one-year rail safety plan following fatal collision
stories.summary: Egypt's Transport Minister Kamel Al-Wazir announced an urgent one-year plan to improve safety across the country's railway network following a fatal passenger train collision south of Cairo.

stories.title: Taiwan's drone industry looks to be booming. Inside, it's much shakier.
stories.summary: Taiwan aims to build a $1.5 billion drone industry by 2030, with drone export sales surging 34 times from 2024 to 2025. Local manufacturers and industry observers warn that weak supply chain management and lack of uniform standards threaten these ambitions.

stories.title: Poland struck by 'drone or missile' near border with Ukraine
stories.summary: A drone or missile struck near Chmielek in Biłgoraj County, Poland, around 6:35am local time, violating NATO airspace. Polish authorities are investigating at least two unknown objects, and Prime Minister Donald Tusk has ordered a meeting with government ministers, security chiefs, and military officials to discuss the incident.

stories.title: MARSS secures US$16m counter-drone contract in the Middle East
stories.summary: MARSS signed a US$16m contract to deploy counter-uncrewed aerial system protection at several sites of national strategic importance in the Middle East. Work begins immediately, with full deployment expected as soon as 2027.

DUCO ROBOTS Expands Smart Manufacturing Presence in Thailand
stories.summary: DUCO ROBOTS officially inaugurated its Thailand subsidiary in Bangkok, marking a step in strengthening localized operations in Southeast Asia. The new office will provide technical support, product testing, and after-sales maintenance for local and neighboring markets.

stories.title: Russian Missiles and a Jet-Powered Drone Entered Polish Airspace, Defence Ministry Says
stories.summary: Polish Defence Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz said Russian missiles and a jet-powered drone violated Polish airspace, with debris found near Mołodycz, Rudnik nad Sanem, and Nowy Lipowiec. Swedish Gripen pilots attempted to intercept a probable Kh-101 missile but did not use weapons, while the objects remained in Polish airspace for up to three minutes.

stories.title: Black Sea Drone Attacks: Romania and Turkey Intensify Security Efforts as Bulgaria Holds Back
stories.summary: Romania and Turkey held seven national security council meetings over six months to address the Russia-Ukraine war, airspace violations, threats to commercial shipping, and the risk of the conflict spreading across the Black Sea region. The latest Romanian session on October 22 focused on protecting commercial vessels and maritime infrastructure.

stories.title: Ukrainian drone engineering meets German manufacturing as QFI ramps up production
Russian attack damages railway infrastructure and causes train delays
stories.summary: Ukrzaliznytsia resumed Kyiv's circular commuter train service despite Russian missile and drone attacks that damaged railway infrastructure and caused delays. The state-run operator stated it is strictly observing safety measures and evacuating passengers when threats arise, while staff work to repair the damaged sections.

stories.title: Indian Army Selects SSS Defence as Lowest Bidder for 84 Indigenous T-12 Anti-Drone Shotguns
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based SSS Defence emerged as the lowest bidder for 84 indigenous T-12 semi-automatic shotguns in an Indian Army procurement process. The 12-gauge weapons, designed to counter low-flying drones at ranges of 50 to 100 metres, are linked to Army requirements at Gwalior.

stories.title: From Dronathon to Doctrine: The Counter-Drone Battle Has Become a Force-Structure Question
stories.summary: The Indian Air Force held its first Dronathon at Pokhran from September 14 to 16, 2026, with more than 20 defense companies participating to examine counter-unmanned technologies. The IAF released its Unmanned Aircraft Systems Roadmap during the event and conducted further industry outreach on October 21, 2026.

stories.title: AUVSI: Drone and AAM Operations Have Scaled, but Part 108 Standards, Security Framework and Public Acceptance Remain the Hurdles
stories.summary: AUVSI listed standards that shape the rules, public acceptance as infrastructure, a workable security framework, and a talent pipeline as four priorities for the year ahead. The organization will keep advocating for timely finalization of Part 108 and will convene stakeholders at the Drone & AAM Policy Symposium and XPONENTIAL 2027 in Miami Beach, May 17–20.

stories.title: State Grid Changzhou Power Supply Company Successfully Develops and Trials an Overhead Line Insulating Sleeve Installation Robot
stories.summary: State Grid Changzhou Power Supply Company completed a pilot operation in Jintan, Changzhou, for an overhead line insulating sleeve installation robot that weighs less than 30 kg. The device, adapted for networks of 35 kV and below, lays 30 meters of sleeves in 15 minutes while ground personnel remotely control it.

stories.title: Collaborative Robotic Welding System Cuts Structural Frame Lead Times by 53
stories.summary: Researchers published a study in the Journal of Intelligent & Robotic Systems showing a collaborative robotic welding system reduced structural frame lead times by up to 53 percent. The automated setup used a 400 A metal active gas welding source on a collaborative robot to handle high-mix, low-volume production for luxury retail fit-out projects.

stories.title: Forum: Safety is the top priority in autonomous vehicle trials
stories.summary: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) stated that all autonomous vehicles in on-road trials must comply with traffic rules and LTA safety requirements, with trained safety operators on board for every journey. LTA will publish quarterly reports on deployment scale, passenger experience, and safety performance starting next month.

stories.title: Russian Air Defenses Down 310 Ukrainian Drones Overnight
stories.summary: Russian air defenses destroyed 310 Ukrainian fixed-wing drones overnight on November 20, targeting multiple regions and the waters of two seas. The attacks killed three people in the Saratov region and injured 13 in Kursk, where 98 buildings and 67 vehicles were damaged.

stories.title: Railway supply industry news round-up
stories.summary: The London Court of International Arbitration ordered Ethiopian Railways Corp to pay Turkish contractor Yapı Merkezi US$307.6m, concluding a dispute over construction works for the Awash – Kombolcha – Hara Gebeya railway which were suspended because of the war in Tigray.

stories.title: Ukrainian Drone Boat Sinks Second Russian Sea Drone
stories.summary: Ukraine’s Sargan 3000 unmanned surface vessel destroyed a Russian uncrewed boat during a Nov. 16 nighttime engagement, marking the platform’s second reported victory in a naval drone duel. The Ukrainian Navy released footage of the attack but did not disclose the location or confirm whether the Russian vessel sank.

stories.title: Robotics enters its post-Jensen Huang era
stories.summary: NVIDIA's board accepted Jensen Huang's resignation on Nov. 12, and CFO Colette Kress is serving as interim CEO while the company searches for a permanent successor. NVIDIA said during its third-quarter earnings call that its physical AI revenue nearly tripled year over year and is on track to exceed $25 billion in fiscal 2027.

stories.title: South Korean Firm Weighs $150 Million Investment in Eric Trump-Backed Military Robot Maker
stories.summary: South Korean conglomerate Base Group is considering a $150 million investment in Foundation Future Industries, a U.S. robotics startup developing humanoid machines for industrial and military applications. The proposed partnership would also involve establishing a joint venture to supply aluminum for robot manufacturing and lithium for batteries.

stories.title: Europeans have created a powerful vehicle for launching dozens of drones—it can use Ukrainian weapons
stories.summary: European company GDELS and Germany's Auterion unveiled the Eagle V 6x6, a combat vehicle equipped with Nemyx VLS vertical launchers for 32 interceptors or 64 strike and reconnaissance drones. The platform is potentially compatible with Ukrainian SkyFall unmanned aerial vehicles, though compatibility with the launchers still needs to be confirmed.

stories.title: Momenta and Uber Launch Robotaxi Pilot in Germany, Offering Free Rides to Passengers
stories.summary: Momenta and Uber launched a Robotaxi pilot in Munich, Germany, on November 18, offering free rides to passengers who request UberX, Electric, or Comfort services in northern Munich. The program allows Momenta to conduct Level 4 autonomous driving tests on urban roads across Germany without needing separate permits for each city.

stories.title: Russia's Geran-6 Drones Could Target Kiev Bridges: Expert
stories.summary: Military analyst Yuri Knutov warned that Russia's new Geran-6 jet drones could target Kiev bridges, while Ukrainian lawmaker Fyodor Venislavsky reported the UAVs reach speeds of up to 1,000 kilometers per hour, potentially challenging Ukrainian air defenses.

stories.title: Lee & Ko to co-host seminar on human-robot coexistence
stories.summary: Lee & Ko and the Korean Society for Internet Ethics will co-host a seminar on human-robot coexistence at 2 p.m. on the 27th at the Hanjin Building in Seoul's Jung District. The event will examine robotics industry development, safety standards, legal liability, and employment transitions through three simultaneous sessions.

stories.title: British Army needs to train almost half of all infantry to use drones, experts warn
stories.summary: The Royal United Services Institute (Rusi) report states that almost half of all the infantry in the British army should be retrained as drone operators. The report says that if Ukrainian levels of UAV use were adopted, approximately 45% of a British Light Infantry Battalion would make up the UAV enterprise.

stories.title: MIIT Unveils 5 Humanoid Robot Industry Standards | Intelligent Capability Classification & Training Site Construction Standards Explained
stories.summary: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology issued five humanoid robot standards on November 16, 2026, covering intelligent capability classification, training site construction, and key components. The new rules establish six capability levels from L0 to L5 and define technical requirements for training sites, integrated electric drive joints, dexterous hands, and training data management.

stories.title: Estonian builder launches semi-autonomous naval vessel demonstrator
stories.summary: Estonia’s Baltic Workboats launched the Euroguard experimental naval vessel at its Nasva shipyard on November 19. The 45-metre semi-autonomous prototype is designed for military missions and testing research systems in actual sea conditions, with a speed of at least 20 knots and a range of around 2,000 nautical miles.

stories.title: Taiwan robot suppliers target 2027 validation, 2028 volume production
stories.summary: Taiwan robot suppliers target 2027 validation and 2028 volume production as Tesla's Optimus enters early production at a California factory.

stories.title: Wisk Opens Hollister Vertiport, NASA Unveils X-70 Fractal, Eve and FlyBIS Sign Up-to-12 eVTOL Deal
stories.summary: Wisk Aero completed and launched its new vertiport at Hollister Municipal Airport in California, described as one of the nation's first public, on-airport vertiports supporting both piloted and autonomous operations. The 100-foot by 100-foot site serves as a dedicated testbed for terminal area procedures, precision landing evaluation, and approach and departure profile validation.

stories.title: AutoFlight Completes Five-eVTOL Formation Flight Across Three Aircraft Models in Kunshan, China
stories.summary: AutoFlight completed a five-eVTOL formation flight across three aircraft models at its Bailian Lake Flight Test Base in Kunshan, China, on October 31 and November 1. The autonomous 47-minute flight involved one 5-ton V5000 Matrix and four 2-ton eVTOLs, with the lead aircraft covering more than 133 km.

stories.title: AIFA Traffic, US Air Outages, Drone Rules: The Week in Aerospace
stories.summary: Felipe Ángeles International Airport projected a 7% passenger increase to 7.6 million travelers in 2026, while a US air traffic control outage disrupted 70 flights at Mexico City International Airport. Commercial drone operators are evaluating forming a Civil Association to modernize airspace regulations, and federal authorities are evaluating four redesigned departure routes at Mexico City International Airport for implementation in March or April 2027.

stories.title: FAA Lists Three Drone-Only TFRs in Utah and California, Anchorage VIP TFR Thursday, White Sands Closures Through Friday
stories.summary: The FAA posted three drone-only security TFRs in Utah and California, a VIP TFR over Anchorage on Thursday, and missile-test closures at White Sands, New Mexico, on Thursday and Friday. A New York City VIP TFR posted for Wednesday afternoon was removed from the live list before its window.

stories.title: 3 armed Philadelphia carjacking suspects arrested in Bensalem with help from drone
stories.summary: Bensalem Township police arrested three armed carjacking suspects in Bensalem after a police drone and license plate readers helped locate them following a Tuesday afternoon theft in Philadelphia. Authorities recovered a loaded .40-caliber handgun and reported no injuries during the apprehension.

stories.title: War Department Advances Unmanned Fleet Coordination
stories.summary: The Department of War advanced its Autonomous Vehicle Orchestrator software program, which enables a single operator to direct a mixed fleet of unmanned vehicles across multiple domains. Launched Jan. 13, 2026, the AVO Challenge focused on developing market-ready software to coordinate disparate unmanned systems into a coordinated team.

Pentagon Advances Software to Fly Mixed Drone Fleets

stories.title: Driverless Trucks Begin Testing on Ohio Roads
stories.summary: Companies began testing autonomous trucks on Ohio roads, with Enride stating it scales the technology only when data supports it. Some groups, including the Owner-operator Independent Drivers Association, called for more oversight before wider deployment.

stories.title: Unions Launch Campaign Against Driverless Ride Pilot
stories.summary: 32BJ SEIU and the App Drivers Union launched a campaign urging New Jersey lawmakers to reject bills S1677 and A3968, which would allow fully autonomous rideshare networks to operate after 100,000 test miles. The unions argue the bills threaten rideshare employment and are targeting the State League of Municipalities conference in Atlantic City.

stories.title: Regent Squire Wing-In-Ground Effect Drone To Patrol Middle East Waters
stories.summary: Regent reached a deal to sell an unspecified number of autonomous Squire Seagliders to a U.S. government customer, CEO Billy Thalheimer announced. The electric-powered drones will form a small fleet deployed in the Middle East next year for multi-domain perception, operating autonomously at up to 70 knots with a range of more than 100 nautical miles.

stories.title: A Driverless Waymo Stopped on San Diego’s Trolley Tracks, Then Reversed Through the Crossing Gate and Broke Its Own Back Window
stories.summary: A Waymo driverless car stopped on trolley tracks at the County Center/Little Italy station in San Diego on Nov. 16, then reversed through the crossing gates and broke its own back window. The San Diego Metropolitan Transit System confirmed the crash, is investigating, and is in contact with Waymo and the California Department of Motor Vehicles.

stories.title: Tesla Robotaxis Drove 705,000 km in One Week in Austin, More Than Waymo: Report
stories.summary: Physical AI Data reported that Tesla's Austin Robotaxi fleet covered an estimated 705,000 km in the week ending October 18, surpassing Waymo's April-to-June weekly average of about 653,000 km in the city.

stories.title: Baton Rouge Police Adds Axon Dedrone Counter-Drone Airspace System
stories.summary: Baton Rouge Police is adding Axon's Dedrone counter-drone technology for real-time airspace security, alongside upgraded body cameras, in-car cameras, TASER devices, and Axon Virtual Reality for officer training.

also.title: Trust Automation Unveils Palletized Counter-Drone System
ACS Showcases Bullfrog Counter-Drone System at SOFEX in Jordan

stories.title: US Air Force announces new focus on sensors and autonomous warfare — with drone-killing kit top of the list
stories.summary: The US Air Force introduced Force Design 2026, a modernization plan prioritizing advanced sensors, artificial intelligence, and autonomous systems to counter aerial threats. The strategy succeeds the One Force Design framework from October 2024 and emphasizes integrating detection technologies with existing aircraft to coordinate operations when conventional communications fail.

stories.title: Flying drone taxis set to hit Phuket next year
XPeng Sets AI Day for November 25 With IRON Robot and Robotaxi
stories.summary: XPeng will hold its eighth AI Day in Guangzhou on November 25, showcasing its IRON humanoid robot and offering rides on driver assistance from NGP up to a Level 4 robotaxi.

also.title: XPENG to Showcase Its Physical AI Push at Annual AI Day, Featuring Its Latest Humanoid Robot in Action

stories.title: Pentagon Seeks New Command to Oversee Autonomous Warfare
stories.summary: The Trump administration's Defense Department is seeking congressional authorization to establish a four-star Autonomous Warfare Command by Oct. 1, 2027, according to a new Congressional Research Service (CRS) report. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth issued a memorandum Sept. 30 directing the Direct Reporting Portfolio Manager for Unmanned Systems to lead Project Agincourt, an initiative intended to establish the new command.

stories.title: MassRobotics Opens Marine Robotics Facility in Boston
stories.summary: MassRobotics opened a marine robotics facility at Boston's Fish Pier, part of Massport's Blue Edge initiative, to provide startups with a practical place to test ocean technology without renting boat time or traveling to remote locations. The site includes a water tank, a float for direct water testing, and lifting equipment, allowing companies to design prototypes in the MassRobotics machine shop and walk them to the pier for same-day harbor testing.

stories.title: Kyiv’s partners should prioritize Ukraine’s domestic drone production
stories.summary: Ukrainian long-range drone strikes reduced Russian oil refining output by around 45 percent since late October, causing renewed fuel shortages and challenging energy exports that fund the Kremlin war machine. The article argues Kyiv’s partners should prioritize Ukraine’s domestic drone production to address the gap between the country’s $30 billion defense procurement plan and its potential $60 billion domestic output.

stories.title: Grapevine Police to establish $1M Drone First Responder Program
stories.summary: The Grapevine Police Department is creating a $1 million Drone First Responder Program with three Skydio X10 drones to respond to calls, provide live video, and assist in investigations. The city council unanimously approved the purchase on Nov. 17, and the department will pay $209,713 annually for five years to own the drones.

stories.title: Deadly Lockland fire sparks new push from Congressman to address blocked railroad crossings
Hackers try to plant malware into Ukraine-bound drones — Germany's Quantum Systems says there's 'no risk' after cyberattack failed
stories.summary: German drone manufacturer Quantum Systems confirmed that unidentified hackers attempted to introduce malicious software into its update distribution system in late October. The company stated the malware did not reach the aircraft themselves, though it circulated through infrastructure belonging to several customers, prompting the Bundeswehr to temporarily suspend operations involving its entire Quantum Systems drone fleet.

stories.title: NRC: Destinus Staff Helped Launch Drones Toward Voronezh
stories.summary: NRC reports that Destinus staff tested explosive drones near Kharkov in 2023 and helped launch them toward Voronezh, where a drone strike injured three people. Destinus denied taking part in military operations, maintaining its activities were limited to providing technical support.

stories.title: MBARI Robot Fleet Tracks Marine Life in California Offshore Wind Zones
EBRD: Morocco expands automotive exports as drone industry gains ground
stories.summary: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development reported that Morocco’s automotive exports now account for approximately 13% of total exports, making it Africa’s largest car exporter. The bank noted that drone-related component exports increased 1.6 times in 2024 compared with the 2019–2021 average, while a partnership between Casava Technologies and Nvidia aims to develop AI factories in Morocco.

stories.title: Tesla’s Cybercab Crashed at 53 MPH on a Philadelphia Highway With a Test Driver Aboard — Then Tesla Redacted What Happened
stories.summary: Tesla filed a crash report with the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration detailing a September collision involving a Cybercab traveling at 53 mph in Philadelphia, but redacted the narrative field as confidential business information. The report lists a test driver aboard, notes the other vehicle's airbag deployed, and leaves injury status unknown.

also.title: Tesla's Cybercab Has Eight Federal Crash Reports Already
Tesla withholds details of 4 Cybercab test crashes, including a 53 mph collision
Tesla Cybercab Crash Files: 5 MPH Bumps and a Redacted 53 MPH Crash

stories.title: UCLA Police Given OK for Ammunition, Drone Purchases
stories.summary: The University of California Board of Regents approved UCLA Police Department purchases of 50 40mm foam-tipped projectile rounds, 1,950 pepperball rounds, and six drones. The report stated the equipment is necessary for campus expansion and the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games, where the campus will house up to 17,000 athletes.

stories.title: China tightens export controls on components for Russian drones
stories.summary: China's Commerce Ministry tightened export controls on drone components, including jet-turbine engines for Russia's Geran series, effective Nov. 18. Exporters must now seek licenses to ship jet and electric drone engines, radio transmitters, and speed controllers.

also.title: Why has China tightened drone component exports, and can the rules slow Russian attacks?
China Tightens Exports of Drone Parts Russia Uses as Putin Meets Xi and Trump in Shenzhen

stories.title: Inside Symbotic’s automated warehouse: robotics, software and Rockwell integration
stories.summary: C&S Wholesale Grocers operates an eight-level automated warehouse in Connecticut using Symbotic's technology, which includes 155 robots and Rockwell Automation's control and networking systems. The facility processes up to 1,350 cases per hour during outbound operations.

stories.title: Reach Power Signs Army CRADA to Beam Power to Small Drones
stories.summary: Reach Power signed a Cooperative Research and Development Agreement with the U.S. Army’s DEVCOM Ground Vehicle Systems Center to test vehicle-mounted wireless power for small uncrewed aircraft. The work will pair Reach’s beamforming hardware with a Valinor Dispatch drone dock and a Red Cat Black Widow reconnaissance drone.

stories.title: Arbe Robotics (NASDAQ:ARBE) Q3 Earnings: Level 3 Radar Win and Counter-Drone Launch Accompany USD 9.0M Net Loss
stories.summary: Arbe Robotics reported a third-quarter 2026 net loss of USD 9.0 million and revenue of USD 0.8 million, while announcing that HiRain’s imaging radar, built on its chipset, was selected for a Level 3 passenger vehicle program in China. The company also launched Alerion, a counter-drone radar, and stated that series-production radar deliveries are planned to start in the fourth quarter of 2027.

stories.title: California High-Speed Rail Authority recovers $1.34M from consultants
stories.summary: California High-Speed Rail Authority recovered $1.34 million in travel payments from four consultants, exceeding the $592,900 its inspector general found unallowable. The authority plans to issue a request for qualifications in December 2026 and consider a proposed award in May 2027.

stories.title: Bullet Train: Surat-Bilimora Section to Get Power on Nov 20
stories.summary: The National High Speed Rail Corporation Limited will energise the 50-km Surat-Bilimora section of the Mumbai-Ahmedabad corridor on November 20. This first section to receive power uses a 2 × 25 kV overhead traction system, with the Ministry of Railways warning that the wires will remain live.

also.title: Surat-Bilimora Bullet Train Stretch Set for Power-Up
First section of Mumbai-Ahmedabad bullet train project to get powered up on November 20

stories.title: EOS Names Kais Mnif President of Counter-Drone Firm MARSS
stories.summary: Electro Optic Systems appointed Kaïs Mnif as President and Chairman of MARSS Group, the counter-drone specialist it acquired in May 2026. Mnif will be based in Nice and report to EOS chief executive Andreas Schwer, while Johannes Pinl remains MARSS chief executive leading sales and growth.

stories.title: Metropolis Roboticsâ SKYE Humanoid Takes the Stage at the IMEC NextGen Manufacturing AI Summit
stories.summary: Metropolis Robotics presented its SKYE humanoid robot at the IMEC NextGen Manufacturing AI Summit in Downers Grove, Ill., on November 12, 2026. The Gurnee-based company demonstrated a phased path to task-ready robots for Illinois manufacturers.

stories.title: Suspicious drone found near intâl border in Sriganganagar, search launched
stories.summary: Security agencies launched a search operation after a suspicious quadcopter drone equipped with a camera, battery and dropping pin was found in a residential colony in Sriganganagar’s Srikaranpur area Thursday, around 8 km inside Indian territory from Indo-Pak border. Sriganganagar SP Harishankar Yadav confirmed the recovery, saying an FSL team had been called to examine the drone, including its camera and chip, to establish its origin and possible links with

stories.title: Türkiye becomes 1st to add unmanned fighter jet to military inventory
stories.summary: Baykar announced Thursday that Türkiye became the first country to add an unmanned fighter jet to its military inventory after delivering three Kızılelma combat aircraft to security forces. The jets completed 600 test and training sorties before entering active service, and Baykar signed a contract with Indonesia this May for 12 Kızılelma aircraft starting in 2028.

stories.title: Autonomous Driving Nears Its ‘ChatGPT Moment,’ T. Rowe Says
Nomadic Raises $6 Million for Drones That Land on and Charge From Power Lines
stories.summary: Munich-based Nomadic raised $6 million in seed funding to expand its drone system that lands on live high-voltage lines to recharge and monitor grid conditions. The company plans to use the capital to grow its fleet and add utility customers in Europe and the United States, with remote drone relocation expected in production by 2027.

also.title: These Drones Park on Power Lines and Recharge From the Lines Themselves

stories.title: From Farm Fields to Oyster Beds: Agricultural Drones Find a New Use
stories.summary: Jeri’s Seafood released more than one million baby oysters into Galveston Bay using an XAG agricultural drone. An FAA spokesman said oyster bed seeding is not considered agriculture, so the operator would need a Part 91 exemption and would have to follow all safety and airspace rules.

stories.title: Boston Dynamics launches next-generation Stretch robot with major reliability upgrades
stories.summary: Boston Dynamics unveiled Stretch Gen 2, an autonomous mobile trailer unloading robot featuring heavy-duty automotive-grade connectors and a modular design that reduces a full swerve drive swap from a full day to about one hour. The robot unloads up to 1000 cases per hour and reaches 90 percent charge in about 75 minutes.

stories.title: Ukraine says drones hit over 2 million Russian targets in 2026, with October tally nearly 2.5 times January’s
stories.summary: Ukraine’s Ministry of Defence said its forces have hit more than 2 million Russian targets with drones since the start of 2026, including more than 320,000 Russian military personnel killed or seriously wounded. October recorded approximately 257,264 hits, almost 2.5 times the figure for January.

stories.title: Drone Operators Face Prosecution After Ignoring Airspace Restrictions in Leicester
stories.summary: Leicestershire Police prosecuted ten drone operators who ignored temporary airspace restrictions during Leicester’s Diwali celebrations. Officers used specialist technology to track the drones, identify the pilots, and seize all 10 aircraft.

stories.title: California Enacts New Requirements for Autonomous Vehicle Remote Operations and First-Responder Interactions
FCC Considers New Rules for Drone Communications and Counter-Drone Radar
stories.summary: The Federal Communications Commission (FCC) is scheduled to consider new rules on November 19 that would expand spectrum access for drone communications and counter-drone technology. The draft proposes opening the 450 MHz band to drone command-and-control communications, permitting AURA Network Systems to consolidate its 54 licensed sites into one nationwide license, and allowing ground-based radar systems to operate in the 24.45–24.65 GHz band on a secondary basis.

also.title: FCC Draft Drone Order Makes 400-Foot Coverage Optional for AURA
FCC Weighs Drone Communications Spectrum Rules
FCC adopts final rules opening 450 MHz band for drone links, allowing drone-detection radar at 24.45–24.65 GHz and updating 800 MHz in-flight broadband rules

stories.title: Amazon-owned Zoox begins robotaxi road tests with employees, their families, and friends aboard
stories.summary: Amazon-owned Zoox began testing its driverless robotaxi in Atlanta's northwest neighborhoods, carrying staff, family members, and friends. The company plans to expand routes and open rides to the public via a mobile app as testing progresses.

stories.title: Meteomatics Opens Weather Drone Base at Oklahoma Airport for NOAA
stories.summary: Meteomatics says it will open a second operational weather drone base at McAlester Regional Airport in Oklahoma, the first at an active US airport. Its Meteodrones fly from 50 to nearly 20,000 feet, feeding National Weather Service forecasts under NOAA’s National Mesonet Program.

stories.title: Amazon Zoox enters Uber platform: driverless rides in Las Vegas
stories.summary: Uber added Amazon-owned Zoox robotaxis to its platform in Las Vegas, allowing passengers to book autonomous rides at no extra surcharge. The partnership includes dedicated pickup and drop-off points at MGM properties, with Los Angeles set to be the next location in 2027.

stories.title: What industrial drone deployments reveal about real-world autonomy challenges
stories.summary: An autonomous drone can complete a carefully planned inspection route in a controlled environment and still struggle with the same route at an operating industrial facility.

stories.title: Tesla's Robotaxi Math: Record Export Share in Shanghai, a Cybertruck Sunset in Texas, and Eight Crash Reports
stories.summary: Tesla announced it will invest €3 billion in its Grünheide plant to build up to one million Cybercab robotaxis a year, while Elon Musk stated the company plans to wind down Cybertruck production in Texas around mid-2027 to build more Cybercabs. The company also invited selected prospects to pre-order the vehicle for $29,990 plus a mandatory $299 monthly subscription, with first deliveries held out for December 2026.

stories.title: Tesla Driverless Model Y: Bold Plan for Up to 7 Riders
stories.summary: Elon Musk revealed plans for an autonomous Model Y without steering wheels or brake pedals that will accommodate six or seven passengers. Tesla has not announced a launch date, price, or production schedule for the vehicle.

also.title: Tesla Plans a Driverless Model Y for Up to Seven People

stories.title: Boston Dynamics, GlobalFoundries expand robotics collaboration
stories.summary: Boston Dynamics said it will begin deploying Spot robots across GlobalFoundries’ global manufacturing network and testing Atlas humanoids onsite. The companies will begin testing the Atlas humanoid robot at GlobalFoundries’ facilities in early 2027 to evaluate usage and train it for specific tasks.

stories.title: Autonomous truck firm Einride's quarterly revenue climbs on new customer additions
stories.summary: Sweden's Einride reported a 27 percent sequential jump in third-quarter constant-currency revenue to SEK 185.9 million ($18.34 million) on Wednesday, adding eight customers since June to reach more than 40 total clients. The company reaffirmed its second-half 2026 revenue guidance of $39 million to $42 million and targets about $250 million in annualized run-rate revenue by December 2027.

stories.title: Russian drone attack kills one in Kyiv and damages Dutch Embassy just after APEC summit ends
stories.summary: Russian drones attacked Kyiv immediately after the APEC summit in China, killing one person and injuring at least four. A drone also hit a building behind the Dutch Embassy, causing minor damage to the facility, though no staff were hurt.

stories.title: Vidhance Brings Camera Drone Tracking to Valkyr's HILDR System
stories.summary: Vidhance and Valkyr Defense Systems signed a development agreement to integrate camera-based drone tracking into HILDR, Valkyr’s close-range counter-drone system. A prototype is scheduled for demonstration to Sweden’s Defence Materiel Administration in March 2027.

stories.title: Domestically produced Russian high speed train to be tested in 2027
stories.summary: Ural Locomotives is developing the EVS360 Bely Krechet high-speed trainset, with Russian Railways expecting delivery for testing during 2027. The project covers 43 eight-car trainsets for the Moskva – St Petersburg line, with commercial services planned to start in April 2028.

stories.title: Denver Roads to See Increase in Autonomous Vehicles
stories.summary: Waymo plans to expand its passenger vehicles to all of metro Denver and Denver International Airport in the coming months, while other operators prepare to launch driverless services in the city.

also.title: Waymo soon will be joined in Denver by self-driving trucks, other autonomous vehicles

stories.title: Dubai certifies second vertiport for Joby air taxi service
stories.summary: Skyports Infrastructure received approval from the UAE’s General Civil Aviation Authority for its Dubai Marina vertiport, completing infrastructure for the first Joby Aviation route. The facility supports up to 21,000 landings annually, with commercial operations targeted for 2027 pending aircraft certification.

also.title: Dubai Marina Vertiport Certified Ahead of Planned Joby Air Taxi Services
Skyports, RTA complete work on Dubai Marina air taxi vertiport

stories.title: Waymo suspends San Francisco robotaxi operations due to street flooding
stories.summary: Waymo paused its San Francisco robotaxi service around 11 AM local time after heavy rain and street flooding left autonomous vehicles stranded in traffic. The company stated it will restart rides when road conditions improve and the forecast looks clear.

stories.title: Marine Corps Order Covers Printed Drones, Sentinel Sells The Factory
U.S. Army to stress test its depots with cheap attack drone production
Feedback Framework Boosts Autonomous Vehicle Decision Making in Complex
stories.summary: Researchers introduced FEDrive-LLM, a feedback-enhanced closed-loop framework for autonomous driving decision making that combines continuous online verification with reflective assessment mechanisms. In experimental simulation benchmarks, the system achieved marked improvements in mission success rates, reduced required operational steps, and sustained higher average driving speeds compared to existing state-of-the-art navigation methods.

stories.title: Amtrak orders longer Airo trains to increase capacity in the Northeast Corridor
stories.summary: Amtrak awarded Siemens Mobility a contract to supply eight rakes of Airo coaches and modernise 18 ACS-64 electric locomotives for Northeast Regional services in the Northeast Corridor.

stories.title: Archer and ForeFlight Begin Integrating AI-Powered ATC Transcription into Flight App
Mountmellick man is one of Ireland’s first robotic apprentices
stories.summary: Cian Barber, a Mountmellick man, is one of nine apprentices in LMETB’s first robotic and automation intake at its Dundalk training centre. The program, developed by an industry consortium and validated by Quality and Qualifications Ireland, offers a pathway to the third year of a degree at Southern Regional College in Armagh.

stories.title: Delhi-Ahmedabad Bullet Train Awaits Project Sanction
stories.summary: The Delhi-Ahmedabad high-speed rail corridor remains at the planning stage without project sanction or construction, according to an Economic Times report. The proposed 886-km route would connect 15 stations across Delhi, Haryana, Rajasthan, and Gujarat, potentially reducing travel time between the two cities to less than four hours.

stories.title: FREQUENTIS powers one of the world's first open-market drone ecosystems as Australia rolls out digital UTM services
stories.summary: Frequentis developed a Flight Information Management System for Airservices Australia, which transitioned into live operations at the end of October. The system supports the country's Uncrewed Aircraft System Traffic Management ecosystem, enabling multiple service providers to connect to a common digital infrastructure for drone flight approvals.

also.title: Airservices launches new drone traffic management system

stories.title: Bolt and Stellantis plan autonomous vehicle trials in Greater Paris from 2028
stories.summary: Bolt, Stellantis and Métropole du Grand Paris announced plans to introduce autonomous mobility services in Greater Paris from 2028, with an initial pilot covering up to five municipalities and potential expansion to more than 30 municipalities by 2030. The project, called the Greater Paris Autonomous Driving Living Lab, has been submitted to the European Commission’s Autonomous Drive Ambition Cities (ADACities) initiative.

stories.title: Florida's $2.5M DFR Drone Fund Claimed in 15 Days; Bradenton Got $25K
stories.summary: Bradenton, Florida approved a $25,000 state grant on November 18 to help its police department buy two more Skydio X10 drones. The money comes from the Florida Department of Law Enforcement’s new Drone as First Responder (DFR) grant program, a $2.5 million fund for the 2026-27 fiscal year.

stories.title: USDA Rail Data: Container Carloads Dominate Major U.S. Carriers
stories.summary: USDA data for the week ending November 14, 2026, shows container traffic as the leading commodity category for major U.S. railroads, with BNSF recording the highest total value at 204,734. BNSF also led originated container traffic with 104,326 carloads, ahead of UP at 70,582 and NS at 63,876.

stories.title: ePlane Selects Lynx Software Platform for e200X eVTOL Computing
inDrive and Pony.ai plan robotaxi services in Kazakhstan
stories.summary: inDrive signed a memorandum of understanding with Pony.ai and Nvidia to explore Level 4 autonomous taxi services in Kazakhstan, identifying Astana as the first potential market. The companies will assess technical, operational, regulatory, and commercial feasibility, with Pony.ai supplying seventh-generation robotaxis, inDrive operating the service, and Nvidia providing AI computing infrastructure.

stories.title: ACUASI director highlights recent updates, potential for drones
stories.summary: Cathy Cahill, director for the Alaska Center for UAS Integration UAF, provided an update on the drone program on Tuesday. ACUASI plans to equip its two Windracer drones with a Detect and Avoid radar system, a critical step needed for drones to operate beyond the line of visual sight.

stories.title: Air taxi developers begin passenger flights under strict FAA guidance
stories.summary: Archer Aviation and Beta Technologies began passenger flights after the Federal Aviation Administration issued each a Special Airworthiness Market Survey Certificate. Beta flies in upstate New York and Vermont, while Archer focuses on Los Angeles, as Joby Aviation applies for the same certificate.

stories.title: DJI M30 Flies for Texas Police Unit That Found Missing Boy, 14
stories.summary: The Garland Police Department drone unit found a missing 14-year-old boy with autism under dense tree cover on Oct. 29. A police drone pilot picked up his heat signature in the woods and guided officers on foot to him.

stories.title: Transit Milestones: Electric Bus Base, Portal North Bridge, Hanford Viaduct, and Hitachi Rail Hub
stories.summary: King County Metro completed Tukwila Base on November 4, its first 100 percent battery-electric bus base in Washington state. NJ TRANSIT and Amtrak announced on November 16 that both tracks of the new Portal North Bridge are in full service, removing a longstanding cause of delays for approximately 450 trains crossing the Northeast Corridor each weekday.

stories.title: Canada – Counter uncrewed aerial systems (urban) sandbox 2027
stories.summary: IDEaS is seeking solutions to detect, track, and identify micro and mini uncrewed aerial systems in an urban environment. From July 26 to 30, 2027, demonstrate your cutting-edge technology in the heart of downtown Ottawa, Ontario.

also.title: Canada Opens Ottawa Counter-Drone Sandbox With $1.75M in Prizes
Canadian defence sandbox invites industry to demonstrate C-UAS tech in Ottawa

stories.title: Hanwha Systems wins first US contract for counter-drone radar
stories.summary: Hanwha Systems secured its first US radar export contract by agreeing to supply short-range active electronically scanned array radars to Rebellion Industries. Deliveries will occur in stages through early 2027, with initial deployment at civilian infrastructure sites including oil refineries and stadiums.

stories.title: First Shift: Port labor risk, component standards and robotics reshape operating priorities
stories.summary: The American Trucking Associations proposed third-party electronic-logging-device certification modeled partly on Canada’s system, seeking stronger testing, lifecycle oversight and data checks after federal regulators accelerated device revocations.

stories.title: Amazon Drone Passed Over Paramotor Wing on Landing, Idaho Pilot Says
stories.summary: Mike Cunningham told Idaho News 6 that an Amazon Prime Air delivery drone passed over the top of his wing while he was about 30 feet off the ground. Amazon told the station its drones can detect and avoid other aircraft on their own, including paragliders that carry no transponder.

stories.title: Aspen Fire Trains to Use AI-Guided Firefighting Drones
Two FAA-Licensed Spaceports Propose 250-Mile Supersonic Test Corridor Across West Texas and New Mexico
stories.summary: Midland International Air & Space Port and the New Mexico Spaceport Authority are partnering with Starfighters Space to develop a 250-nautical-mile supersonic test corridor across West Texas and southern New Mexico. The parties are working under a letter of intent to create a regulated alternative to special flight authorizations as the FAA moves toward ending its supersonic ban.

Spaceport America, Midland sign letter of intent to launch flight test corridor, space launch range
Midland and New Mexico Spaceports Team Up on 250-Nautical-Mile Supersonic Test Corridor

stories.title: No Train, No Problem?
ORR Authorises Bristol Brabazon Station for Passenger Services
stories.summary: The Office of Rail and Road (ORR) authorised Bristol Brabazon station to begin passenger services on Monday, 23 November. The new station will restore passenger services to the Henbury Line for the first time since 1964, offering an initial hourly service operated by Great Western Railway (GWR) with connections to Bristol Temple Meads.

stories.title: Supersonic jets want a comeback. But can Americans stand the boom?
stories.summary: In 1971, Congress cut off funding for the SST, and two years later the FAA banned civilian supersonic flight over U.S. soil. Today, prompted by a 2025 executive order, the FAA is proposing to lift that ban before any community response tests of emerging supersonic technology have taken place.

stories.title: Machina Aims to Democratize Car Customization with Innovative Robots
stories.summary: Machina Labs launched Machina Rebellis to provide automakers with a flexible metal manufacturing process that skips costly retooling for limited-production models. The company demonstrated its RoboCraftsman platform by building the Lassen, a customized Toyota Tacoma, in two and a half weeks, a task that typically takes four to six months via traditional methods.

stories.title: Delhi-Mumbai bullet train in under 6 hours? 15 stations, 4 states and one missing link in India's high-spe
stories.summary: The article does not contain information about the Delhi-Mumbai bullet train project, its 15 stations, 4 states, or target travel time.

stories.title: Allies announce new air-defence and drone support commitment to Ukraine at 37th Ramstein meeting
stories.summary: International partners announced new funding and equipment for Ukraine’s air defence and counter-drone capabilities following the 37th Ukraine Defense Contact Group meeting in Brussels on 17 November. The support packages include Ukrainian interceptor drones, systems to counter jet-powered Shahed drones, air defence missiles, radars and funding for domestic drone production, according to Ukraine’s Ministry of Defence.

stories.title: HENSOLDT partners with ZF to expand production of Spexer counter-drone radars
stories.summary: HENSOLDT signed a cooperation agreement with ZF Friedrichshafen AG on 18 November to expand production capacity for its Spexer radar family. ZF will establish a scalable series production facility and develop an automated testing system, while HENSOLDT retains all intellectual property rights.

also.title: HENSOLDT Hands Spexer Drone-Defence Radar Production to ZF

stories.title: Florida Dentist Accused of Drone Stalking Ex-Wife, Hiding the Drone
stories.summary: Palm Beach County sheriff’s deputies arrested Jacques Benchimol, 45, after following a drone to his location near his ex-wife’s home in West Boca Raton on November 9. Benchimol faces three charges, including cyberstalking and drone surveillance, and allegedly concealed the drone in a gray Mercedes when he noticed the officers.

stories.title: Knoxville Police Drones Launch With a Ban on Face and Plate Scans
stories.summary: The Knoxville Police Department started flying Skydio drones from 12 docks on November 19 to respond to 911 calls. The department's policy states that drones do not perform facial recognition or collect ALPR data.

stories.title: From Berlin to Brussels: Tesla's $3.3 Billion Robotaxi Gamble
stories.summary: Tesla committed approximately $3.3 billion to expand its Berlin facility to produce up to one million autonomous Cybercabs annually starting in 2029, despite current European Union rules limiting fully driverless car registrations to 1,500 units per model each year.

stories.title: At Apple, the robots are coming
stories.summary: An Industrial Automation 2026 report claims US manufacturing has spent $51 billion on robotics and automation this year, with spending expected to exceed $84 billion by 2030. The report states global industrial robot stock hit roughly 5.0 million units in 2025, up 9% year-over-year, while annual installations topped 600,000 units, up 11%.

stories.title: Heavy Haul Conference 2026: Collaboration Key to Unlocking Rail Capacity in Multi-Operator Environment
stories.summary: A panel at the South African Heavy Haul Association Conference 2026 in Gauteng on November 18 stated that greater collaboration among infrastructure managers, freight operators, mining companies and port terminals is needed to unlock rail capacity in a multi-operator environment.

stories.title: Valkryn Emerges From Stealth To Test Autonomous Military Systems
stories.summary: Valkryn emerged from stealth to develop test environments and evaluation software for drones, robots, and autonomous defense systems. The company aims to replace fragmented testing processes with standardized evidence of system performance in realistic conditions.

stories.title: Ukraine plans to double drone supplies, triple deep strikes
stories.summary: Ukraine plans to double its drone supplies and more than triple its long-range strike capabilities next year, according to Defense Minister Yevhenii Khmara. The British government will send Ukraine more than 1,000 long-range strike drones in a roughly $342 million package, while Germany pledged to buy jointly produced drones and Norway promised $300 million for Ukrainian drones.

also.title: UK to provide Ukraine with long-range drones as part of £260m package

stories.title: Tesla Cybercab Spec Page Shows 279-Mile Range, 123 Miles in 15 Minutes
stories.summary: Tesla rates its Cybercab at 279 miles of EPA-estimated range and says Supercharging adds 123 miles in 15 minutes, according to the specifications page on the order site shown to customers invited to buy the two-seater for personal use.

stories.title: Army Trains 1st Cavalry Artillery To Ram Drones With Bumblebee V2
stories.summary: Joint Interagency Task Force 401 trained 1st Cavalry Division Artillery soldiers on the Bumblebee V2 quadcopter at Fort Hood, Texas, from November 2 to 13. The Pentagon’s counter-drone task force announced the exercise on November 18, describing the aircraft as a dual-use system for reconnaissance and kinetic interception.

stories.title: 10,000 trains and counting: China's auto export rail service picks up speed
stories.summary: A train carrying 203 domestically made new energy vehicles departed from Zhengzhou International Land Port on Thursday, marking the milestone of 10,000 special trains for exported finished vehicles transported by dedicated rail wagons. Since the start of this year, more than 2.035 million finished vehicles have been exported via rail, a 79% year-on-year increase.

stories.title: Stanford Gave 100 Students 48 Hours to Fly a Drone With No GPS
stories.summary: Stanford University hosted its first drone hackathon from November 6 to 8, where 100 students from 28 universities spent 48 hours writing software to fly quadcopters through an indoor obstacle course without GPS. A five-person team named Fat Kestrel won the $7,000 top prize after their drone successfully completed the course and returned to the start.

stories.title: Blysk Anti-Drone Laser System Enters Combat Duty in Kyiv, Carmine Sky Says
stories.summary: Ukrainian defense company Carmine Sky deployed its Blysk laser system in Kyiv in early November to counter Russian attack drones. The 4 kW system has a stated engagement range of up to one kilometre and did not engage targets during its first few days due to cloudy and foggy weather.

stories.title: Imagry and Endera to Introduce First Buy America-Compliant Autonomous Buses and Shuttles
stories.summary: Imagry announced a partnership with Endera to deliver the first Buy America-compliant autonomous buses and shuttles for US public transit. The companies will pair Imagry’s Level 4 autonomous driving system with Endera’s American-built vehicles to provide self-driving options purchasable entirely with federal transit funds.

stories.title: KNDS launches AI-based FENNEK AIR mobile counter-UAS prototype at NEDS
stories.summary: KNDS Deutschland is presenting a prototype of FENNEK AIR, an artificial intelligence-enabled mobile counter-uncrewed aircraft system vehicle, at the NIDV Exhibition Defence & Security in Rotterdam, Netherlands, on 19 November. The vehicle is equipped with KNDS France’s ARX30 remote-controlled weapon station and a 30 mm automatic cannon configured for counter-drone missions.

also.title: KNDS Shows AI Counter-Drone FENNEK AIR Prototype at NEDS
KNDS Fennek Air counter-drone prototype combines AI decision support with a 30 mm cannon

stories.title: US, Morocco test autonomous systems at Africa Multidomain Training and Experimentation Center to accelerate warfighter readiness

also.title: US, Morocco Put Autonomous Counter-UAS Ground Vehicles to the Test at New Africa Training Center

stories.title: Bi-mode locomotives to be ordered amid lukewarm response to French night train fleet renewal tenders
stories.summary: The French national government agreed to order new bi-mode locomotives from Stadler through Alpha Trains to power domestic overnight passenger trains in the Trains d’Équilibre du Territoire network.

stories.title: Amtrak Joins Texas Central on Dallas-Houston Rail
stories.summary: Amtrak and Texas Central are evaluating a partnership to study a proposed 390 km high-speed rail line between Dallas and Houston, which would operate at up to 330 km/h using Shinkansen technology. The companies have applied for federal support through three grant programmes, with decisions and the outcome of the Amtrak evaluation remaining pending.

stories.title: Forsyth County Sheriff establishes first U.S. A2Z AirDock network, expanding drone-as-first-responder capabilities
stories.summary: A2Z Drone Delivery announced that the Forsyth County Sheriff’s Office launched the nation’s first A2Z AirDock network, enabling a fleet of Longtail Patrol drones to cover up to 200 square miles around Winston-Salem, NC. The automated docking stations support rapid deployment for search-and-rescue, criminal investigations, and AED delivery, having flown more than 500 miles in its initial weeks.

also.title: Forsyth County Establishes US Public Safety Network of Automated Drone Docks

stories.title: China Develops Military Drone That Fires Painkiller Darts at Wounded Troops
stories.summary: China's Air Force Medical University developed the first casualty-search drone for the People's Liberation Army, which fires darts loaded with painkillers to treat wounded soldiers from a distance. The system aims to keep medical teams out of harm's way and buy critical time for further treatment.

stories.title: Top Robotics And Industrial Automation Startups In Estonia To Watch In 2027
stories.summary: Estonian robotics startups raised €93 million in equity funding in 2026, making it the country’s top sector by capital raised. The funding supports diverse applications, including Milrem Robotics’ unmanned ground vehicles for military use and Starship Technologies’ self-driving sidewalk delivery robots.

stories.title: LASE to Premiere Quantum Bullet(TM) at Counter UAS Technology Conference in Washington, D.C.
stories.summary: LASE Corp. will premiere its Quantum Bullet™ anti-drone platform at Counter UAS Technology USA in Washington, D.C., from November 30 through December 2, 2026. Executive Chairman Dmitri Nikitin will present as a featured speaker at the event, which brings together military, government, and industry leaders to address unmanned aerial system threats.

stories.title: Arrive AI Robot Adds Daily Specimen Runs at Hancock Health Lab
stories.summary: Arrive AI announced that Hancock Health is adding a second Arrive Point receiving unit at its Parkway Building in Greenfield, Indiana. An autonomous ground robot will make four to five scheduled runs a day carrying specimens to the Hancock Regional Hospital laboratory, with on-demand trips for urgent orders.

stories.title: US company Poseidon Aerospace cuts Egret military cargo drone development by 18 months using AI
stories.summary: Flexcompute announced on November 17, 2026, that its partnership with Poseidon Aerospace shortened the development schedule of the Egret P50-E-01 and Heron P50-H-01 autonomous cargo aircraft by 18 months using AI-assisted simulations. The collaboration reduced aerodynamic database creation from eight months to three weeks and enabled ten times more simulations, supporting planned full-scale flight testing for commercial and U.S. military logistics.

stories.title: US Air Force Drone Lockdown Was Three Small Planes, Pilot Says
stories.summary: Ferry pilot Sam Rutherford told the BBC that three Cirrus SR20 light aircraft he was flying in were mistaken for drones during a lockdown at RAF Lakenheath on November 13. Moldova’s Civil Aviation Authority confirmed two days later that three SR20s arriving from the Czech Republic were filmed and shared online as drones over Chișinău.

also.title: Drone alert at RAF Lakenheath ‘triggered by three light aircraft’
Ex-British Army pilot says HE caused the drone alert at RAF Lakenheath

stories.title: Zipline launches drone delivery service for Uber Eats customers in Houston
stories.summary: Zipline launched autonomous drone deliveries for Uber Eats customers in Houston on 17 November, allowing users to select the “by drone” option in the app. The service, which uses aircraft flying at approximately 330 feet to deliver payloads of up to eight pounds, will initially serve Houston before expanding to Dallas and additional US cities.

stories.title: PODCAST | Where can eVTOL designers save weight? Greene Tweed’s David Jhaveri makes the case for thermoplastic composites
Amtrak Adds Second Daily Pennsylvanian Round Trip
stories.summary: Amtrak launched a second daily Pennsylvanian round trip between New York and Pittsburgh on November 18, 2026, using $143.6 million in Federal Railroad Administration funding. Pennsylvania also invested more than $80 million in Keystone West infrastructure projects, which the state expects to complete by 2030.

also.title: All aboard! Government leaders welcome second Amtrak train connecting Pittsburgh and New York City

stories.title: Infrabel selects supplier for 90-locomotive framework contract
stories.summary: Infrabel selected Stadler for a framework contract covering the supply and maintenance of up to 90 locomotives to renew its engineering fleet.

stories.title: Waymo hit pause in San Francisco after robotaxis reportedly blocked traffic
stories.summary: Waymo temporarily paused San Francisco robotaxi rides on November 18, 2026, after vehicles reportedly obstructed traffic during flooding. The company’s app stated service would resume when road conditions improve and the forecast looks clear, but provided no specific restart time.

stories.title: Humanoid Robot Multi-fingered Dexterous Hand Market Positioning Strategy in 2026: Identifying Unique Value Pro
stories.summary: QYResearch projects the global humanoid robot multi-fingered dexterous hand market will reach USD 5,040 million by 2030, expanding at a compound annual growth rate of 64.6%.

stories.title: Ukrainian Harpoon Surface Drone for Strike and Special Missions Receives NATO Codification
stories.summary: NOAH X announced that its Harpoon unmanned surface vessel received a NATO Stock Number, allowing Ukraine's Defense Forces to officially use the platform. The 2.05-meter drone features waterjet propulsion, a 50-kilometer range, and a 30-kilogram payload capacity.

stories.title: Rhein-Ruhr cities pool resources to place joint tram order
stories.summary: Škoda Group won a joint order to supply 50 low-floor trams to operators in Essen, Krefeld, and Oberhausen, with options for 29 more.

stories.title: Tesla’s Cybercab fleet just had its biggest day ever
stories.summary: Tesla opened public Cybercab rides in Dallas on November 19, 2026, making it the second U.S. city after Austin to receive the two-seat, steering-wheel-free vehicle. Riders can book through the Tesla Robotaxi app, joining unsupervised Model Y Robotaxis that have operated in Dallas since April.

also.title: Tesla Cybercab robotaxi expands to Dallas after Austin

stories.title: Germany's Rheinmetall Is Developing Humanoid Combat Robots, but How Feasible Is Idea Today?
stories.summary: German defense giant Rheinmetall plans to present the first prototypes of humanoid combat robots within the next 15–18 months. The company is already actively investing in this field, and the upper body of such a robot is currently under development.

stories.title: Denver Seeks State Rules for Self-Driving Cars
stories.summary: Denver City Council is seeking state legislation to regulate self-driving cars, citing limits on local enforcement under a 2017 Colorado law. Waymo operates 60 automated cars in Denver, and police could not issue a ticket for speeding in a school zone because no driver was present. State lawmakers are expected to discuss self-driving car regulations in the 2027 legislative session.

stories.title: High-speed rail in Texas? Austin and San Antonio city leaders push for possibility
China Shows Off Stealth GJ-11 Combat Drone
stories.summary: China's state broadcaster released footage of its GJ-11 stealth combat drone, exposing internal weapons compartments, retractable landing gear, and nose-mounted sensors. Chinese military sources identified airstrikes and suppression of enemy air defenses as intended missions.

stories.title: What Does Toyota Motor (TSE:7203) Going Driverless In Guangzhou Change?
stories.summary: Toyota Motor and Pony.ai launched fully driverless commercial robotaxi services in Guangzhou using the Gen 7 bZ4X Robotaxi. The partners plan to scale the fleet toward 1,000 units across China as production ramps.

stories.title: Humyn Labs raises $47M to collect real-world data for robotics
stories.summary: Humyn Labs raised $47 million in Series A funding to collect real-world data for robotics, having surpassed $50 million in annualized revenue within six months of operations. The round includes $26 million in equity led by Accel and $21 million in venture debt led by Lighthouse Canton, supporting deployment readiness infrastructure in Brazil, Korea, and India.

stories.title: Amazon Said Quitting Unwilling Towns 'Would Probably Not Happen'
stories.summary: Amazon withdrew its Westborough, Massachusetts, site-plan application on November 10 after the town voted 510 to 13 to ban drone launch pads. The company told the Boston Globe it will file a revised project soon, while the Zoning Board of Appeals meets December 7 to decide on a residents' appeal.

stories.title: UAV Navigation's HES01 Puts Drones on Ship Decks, if GPS Survives
Airbus U010 Aliaca Drone Receives Qualification from French Armament General Directorate (DGA)
stories.summary: The French Armament General Directorate (DGA) qualified the VTOL variant of Airbus Helicopters’ U010 Aliaca drone after tests in May and June 2026. The first two systems will be delivered to the French Navy in September, with eight of the 34 ordered systems featuring this new variant.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia seeks counter-drone arms from Türkiye and the West as Yemen war deepens
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia is seeking counter-drone systems from Western partners and Türkiye to deter Houthi attacks in Yemen, with officials stating the kingdom is in the market for available equipment. A Saudi delegation led by Bandar al-Khorayef met Turkish procurement head Haluk Gorgun last week, while the country has postponed major global events until autumn 2027 at the earliest.

stories.title: Wing Flies 6 Miles Out of Ponchatoula. The City's Say Ends at the Lot
stories.summary: Wing’s Walmart drones in Ponchatoula, Louisiana, deliver up to six miles from the store, Mayor Wesley Daniels told Baton Rouge station WBRZ in a report published Monday, November 16. More than a dozen of them sit in a fenced nest in the middle of the parking lot at the Walmart off US-51.

stories.title: Ecuadorian Fishermen Sue US Over Galápagos Drone Strike That Sank Boat
stories.summary: The crew of La Negra Francisca Duarte II sued the United States government in federal court in western Pennsylvania on Monday, alleging American forces sent armed drones that sank their boat near the Galápagos Islands on March 17. The complaint lists 18 plaintiffs and seeks damages, while the Defense Department and Coast Guard have denied responsibility for the attack.

also.title: Ecuadorian fishermen sue US government over 'war crime' drone strike at sea

stories.title: Zipline Hires Uber Veteran For 20 African Hubs While Ghana Owes It
stories.summary: Zipline hired Anthony le Roux, a 13-year Uber executive, as its Head of Operations for Africa from January 2027 to build at least 20 new distribution centres across the continent within two years. The first 10 are agreed with Côte d’Ivoire, while Ghana’s health minister told Parliament in July that the government still owed Zipline about GH¢175 million.

also.title: Zipline Appoints Uber Veteran to Lead 20 New Drone Delivery Centres Across Africa

stories.title: Amazon delays Tallahassee debut of Prime Air drone delivery service
stories.summary: Amazon delayed the launch of its Prime Air drone delivery service in Tallahassee from mid-November to the end of the year. The optional premium service costs $4.99 and operates within a 7.5-mile radius of the Mahan Drive fulfillment center.

stories.title: Rail Freight Fraud: Organized Crime’s New Tactic?
stories.summary: Trinity Industries CEO Bill Stephens said the railcar market is tightening as new builds run roughly 15,000 units below annual scrappage, a deficit he expects to intensify through 2027. He noted that steel prices rose 63% year over year at the end of the third quarter, reinforcing lease rate gains across the fleet.

stories.title: Amazon drone delivery coming to parts of Hampton Roads next year, company says
stories.summary: Amazon will launch Prime Air drone delivery in Suffolk, Virginia, early next year, covering a 7.5-mile radius from its ORF3 fulfillment center. The service will deliver packages weighing up to 5 pounds within 30-60 minutes, with free delivery for Prime members on orders over $50.

stories.title: Event 38 Unmanned Systems and Parallax Advanced Research Collaborate to Integrate Vigilant Spirit Ground Control Station with E455 VTOL UAS
stories.summary: Event 38 Unmanned Systems and Parallax Advanced Research are collaborating to integrate the Vigilant Spirit Ground Station with Event 38’s E455 Fixed-Wing VTOL UAS. The effort demonstrates the flexibility of the E455’s open architecture and its ability to support emerging command and control technologies for defense and government applications.

stories.title: BRINC Drones Launches New iOS App to Improve First Responder Situational Awareness
stories.summary: BRINC launched the BRINC LiveOps iOS app, giving authorized first responders real-time access to live drone video, airspace conditions, and agency operations from their iPhone or iPad. The app, available now on the Apple App Store, integrates with existing public safety systems and stores data in a CJIS-compliant environment with AES-256 encryption.

stories.title: Ukraine Tests 9 DJI Mavic Replacements With a 60-Minute Flight Bar
stories.summary: Ukraine’s defense-tech cluster Brave1 and the Ministry of Defense tested Mavic-type reconnaissance drones from nine Ukrainian manufacturers. The makers whose aircraft proved combat-ready are now moving to contracts to supply military units.

stories.title: Ukraine plans to double drone supplies in 2027 and expands defence AI cooperation with Denmark
stories.summary: Ukrainian Defence Minister Evgeniy Khmara announced plans to double drone supplies in 2027, stating unmanned systems will account for more than half of the country’s weapons requirements next year. On 18 November, Ukraine and Denmark signed a letter of intent for strategic cooperation in defence AI and data, including Denmark’s entry into the Avengers Labs platform.

stories.title: From Commercial Scale to Embodied Intelligence: The Next Challenge for Robotics
stories.summary: Pudu Robotics presented its One Brain, Multiple Embodiments strategy at its European Partner Summit in Amsterdam on November 4. The company, which has shipped more than 130,000 robots across over 85 countries, introduced PuduFM and PuduAgent as core technologies for its embodied AI portfolio.

stories.title: Red Cat Withdraws 2026 Revenue Forecast as Defense Contracts Progress More Slowly Than Expected
stories.summary: Red Cat Holdings withdrew its full-year 2026 revenue forecast on November 16, citing slower-than-expected defense funding and contract awards. The company reported third-quarter revenue of $11.8 million and noted that the Pentagon’s Drone Dominance Gauntlet II competition removed an anticipated contributor to near-term revenue.

stories.title: Pentagon Selects Seven Counter-Drone Laser Systems for Live-Fire Competition
Uber commits $50m to expand autonomous vehicle services across Dubai by 2027
stories.summary: Uber committed Dh184 million ($50 million) over the next two years to expand autonomous-vehicle services across Dubai, including door-to-door journeys in Jumeirah and Umm Suqeim by the end of next year. The investment supports the Dubai Autonomous Transportation Strategy, which aims to make 25 per cent of all transport trips in the emirate autonomous by 2030.

stories.title: Putnam Sheriff Pitches $312K Police Drones as Neighbors Hold Waivers
stories.summary: Putnam County Sheriff Brian Hess will pitch a $312,000 Drone as First Responder program to the Protective Services Committee on November 18, after legislators held the funds in contingency pending public briefing. The proposed 2027 budget allocates $60,000 for three Skydio drones, though Hess previously cited a plan for six drones and a $276,000 cost.

stories.title: AUVSI Names Brett Feddersen President and CEO, Succeeding Michael Robbins
stories.summary: The Association for Uncrewed Vehicle Systems International (AUVSI) named Brett Feddersen as its next President and CEO, effective December 1, 2026. Feddersen succeeds Michael Robbins, who left the organization in October to lead the Semiconductor Industry Association.

stories.title: Rockwell Automation acquiring mobile robot maker AGILOX
stories.summary: Rockwell Automation signed a definitive agreement to acquire Austria-based AGILOX, a move that will more than double the size of its autonomous mobile robot business. The deal is expected to close in the second quarter of Rockwell’s fiscal 2027, subject to regulatory approval.

stories.title: Roamly Announces Insurance for Tesla Cybercab
stories.summary: Roamly launched Autonomous Vehicle insurance for the Tesla Cybercab, allowing owners to insure the fully autonomous vehicle under one digital policy alongside other cars. The coverage connects to native Tesla telemetry without added hardware, following Tesla's decision to open Cybercab orders to select customers with deliveries expected to begin in December 2026.

stories.title: Chinese Drone Shoots Rice Seeds Into Mud, Lifts Yield 11% in Trial
stories.summary: Researchers at South China Agricultural University in Guangzhou developed a drone seeding system that shoots germinated rice into a paddy in rows, yielding 6,731 kg per hectare in a November 2025 trial. This 11% gain over conventional broadcasting drones resulted from a semi-open impeller pump that fired seed slurry in 10 Hz pulses to limit rotor downwash interference.

stories.title: Inside China's relentless race to develop humanoid robot helpers and get them into our homes
Blue UAS Supplier Lantronix Says Its China Exit Has Only Started
stories.summary: Lantronix CEO Saleel Awsare told Military.com that the Irvine, California company has moved 98% of its supply chain out of China, relying on suppliers in Taiwan, Thailand, and Vietnam. Awsare stated that the process of moving production back to the United States has only just started, with printed circuit boards remaining particularly difficult to relocate.

stories.title: TU Delft Drone Feels Its Way to a Perch, Then Kills Its Motors
stories.summary: Delft University of Technology researchers published a quadcopter design that perches by touch, achieving a 99% success rate in simulations with target estimates off by up to 2 feet. The drone uses a spring-loaded, three-fingered hand to locate and grip branches, switching off its motors to conserve energy.

stories.title: Waymo suspends driverless freeway rides after California safety order
stories.summary: Waymo suspended driverless freeway rides in all markets after California’s Department of Motor Vehicles barred its robotaxis from state freeways. The DMV cited two recent incidents, including vehicles entering a construction closure on U.S. 101, and described the operations as an imminent hazard to public safety.
